intro.text: Bawky Studio is a small team with a big love for making games that hit differently. We believe that humor and personality are what make a game truly shine.

philosophy.title: ⚡ Philosophy
philosophy.text: We craft games that make players laugh, shout, and question everything. If it’s weird but fun. that’s our territory.

focus.title: 🎮 Focus
focus.text: Multiplayer, mind games, and experimental systems that make every session unpredictable. just how we like it.

team.title: MEMBERS
team.Hyuki: My future self is cheering for who i am today

promise.title: OUR PROMISE
promise.text: “We create games that are as fun to make as they are to play”

join.title: JOIN OUR TEAM
join.text: We're always on the lookout for developers, artists, and weird minds who love making unconventional games. If you think you’d fit right in, we’d love to hear from you.
